text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While riding the bus to summer camp…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: We really must make the most of camp this year and refine my running. I hope to come away having surpassed even Suzuka…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Teehee. Well, I'm pleased to be correct. For a moment there, I thought I might have said something silly…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That's a relief… Wait, no. It's not. Our goal is so clear that the lurking danger has come into view, too.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: When Silence Suzuka runs, she starts by leaping ahead, then maintains that momentum all the way to the finish line.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With no flaws whatsoever, she's the ultimate ideal and embodies a perfection the likes of which defies reason.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The only way we can possibly beat her is to find a situation where we can outpace her overwhelming speed. But when would we get that chance?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Maybe we could make things work with a long-distance race, but if it's medium-distance…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Knowing us, I'm quite sure we'll be fine. We've overcome plenty of hurdles already, after all.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her softly spoken words give me hope. It's a long shot, but maybe… Just maybe…
choice_data_list: Can you envision how you're going to run?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I suppose it was unrealistic to expect a practical plan. That said, pessimism won't help either.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This summer, there's really only one option available to us…
choice_data_list: Why don't we see what they have to say?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With our sights set on such a strong adversary, I decide that our best bet will be to gather all the wisdom we can from the Mejiro family over the summer.
